description: Release pin of the files a converted-book edition ships besides its text: the author-selected cover (decision "3 and 2", 28 October 2026; record docs/design/2026-10-28-two-book-conversion/selected-covers-2026-10-28.json) and, by reference, the nine interactive documents whose hashes are recorded in src/books/next-books/next-books-provenance.json (outputs).
